title: Document AI System
tagline: Structured, validated data out of any document format.

meta.title: Document AI System | Foxtroit AI
meta.description: Structured, validated data out of any document format.

blocks.title: The Problem
blocks.content: Extracting accurate structured data from unstructured business documents — invoices, KYC forms, contracts — still means manual review to catch errors.

blocks.title: The Solution
blocks.content: OCR feeds an LLM for contextual field extraction, validated against a JSON schema with strict datatypes, with workflows configurable per document type via an admin panel.

blocks.title: Outcome
blocks.content: Enterprise-scale document processing with output stable enough to feed straight into other systems.
